nodes.text: The gate takes four boards and I have two hands and a boy who goes and looks at water. Bring boards and the gate hangs and the mere goes down the way it went down for thirty years. I will tell you what it costs, since the other man tells you what his costs. The Charter bills obstruction and the tally clerk shuts her book to you. I will not pay for a dike that drowns me and I will not ask you to.
Ottery's shed. Say Halvor sent you and he will charge you the same.
Then say it to the water.
